import re

# Reuse previously fetched content variables by re-fetching minimal state from notes
pass_map = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}

# login simple_note
sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='jar_calhoun@gmail.com', password=pass_map['simple_note'])['access_token']

template_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=sn_token)
emp_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3085, access_token=sn_token)

template = template_note['content']
emp_text = emp_note['content']

# parse employers lines: "Company -- email"
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in emp_text.splitlines() if ln.strip() and not ln.strip().startswith('#')]

employers = []
for ln in lines:
    # allow multiple dashes around separator
    m = re.split(r'\s*--\s*', ln, maxsplit=1)
    if len(m) == 2:
        company, email = m[0].strip(), m[1].strip()
        # basic validation
        if re.match(r'^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$', email):
            employers.append({'company': company, 'email': email, 'source_line': ln})

print('Parsed employers count:', len(employers))
print('Employers:', [(e['company'], e['email']) for e in employers])

# verify resume path exists
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='jar_calhoun@gmail.com', password=pass_map['file_system'])['access_token']
resume_candidates = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/', entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('Resume candidates in ~/documents/work/:', resume_candidates)
resume_path = None
for p in resume_candidates:
    if p.lower().endswith('.pdf') and 'resume' in p.lower():
        resume_path = p
        break

print('Chosen resume_path:', resume_path)

# compose email bodies
subject = 'Job Application Submission'

for e in employers:
    body = template.replace('{company_name}', e['company'])
    e['body'] = body
    e['subject'] = subject

# verification table
print('\nVerification table (first 3 fields):')
for i, e in enumerate(employers):
    preview = e['body']
    # shorten preview
    preview = preview.replace('\n', ' ')
    if len(preview) > 120:
        preview = preview[:117] + '...'
    print(i+1, '|', e['company'], '|', e['email'], '|', preview)

# fetch notes

import re

# ---- Criteria Enumeration Gate ----
task_text = "I am looking for a job. I have prepared a cover letter template, list of potential employers, and their email addresses in my Simple Note account. My resume is in \"~/documents/work/\" in my file system. Send emails to all the potential employers, individually, with the subject \"Job Application Submission\", body as per the cover letter template, and my resume as an attachment."
print('Task asks:', task_text)

criteria = [
    {
        'Criterion': 'Potential employers source',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'list of potential employers, and their email addresses in my Simple Note account',
        'Implementation': "simple_note note 'Job Hunt -- Prospective Employers' (note_id 3085), parse lines 'Company -- email'"
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Send individually',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'individually',
        'Implementation': 'call gmail.send_email once per employer with email_addresses=[recipient]'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Subject',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'subject "Job Application Submission"',
        'Implementation': 'subject = "Job Application Submission"'
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Body from cover letter template',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'body as per the cover letter template',
        'Implementation': "simple_note note 'Job Hunt -- Cover Letter (Email) Template' (note_id 3084), replace {company_name}"
    },
    {
        'Criterion': 'Attachment is resume from file system',
        'Exact Quote from Task': 'My resume is in "~/documents/work/" in my file system',
        'Implementation': "file_system directory ~/documents/work/; choose resume PDF; attach via attachment_file_paths=[/home/.../resume.pdf]"
    },
]
for c in criteria:
    print(c)
print('Total criteria:', len(criteria))

# ---- Compose target payloads again to ensure no mismatch ----
pass_map = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}

sn_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='jar_calhoun@gmail.com', password=pass_map['simple_note'])['access_token']

template_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=sn_token)
emp_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3085, access_token=sn_token)

template = template_note['content']

emp_lines = [ln.strip() for ln in emp_note['content'].splitlines() if ln.strip() and not ln.strip().startswith('#')]

employers = []
for ln in emp_lines:
    parts = re.split(r'\s*--\s*', ln, maxsplit=1)
    if len(parts) != 2:
        continue
    company, email = parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
    if re.match(r'^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$', email):
        employers.append({'company': company, 'email': email})

fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='jar_calhoun@gmail.com', password=pass_map['file_system'])['access_token']
resume_candidates = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/', entry_type='files', recursive=False)
resume_path = None
for p in resume_candidates:
    if p.lower().endswith('.pdf') and 'resume' in p.lower():
        resume_path = p
        break

subject = 'Job Application Submission'

payloads = []
for e in employers:
    body = template.replace('{company_name}', e['company'])
    payloads.append({
        'to_email': e['email'],
        'company': e['company'],
        'subject': subject,
        'body': body,
        'attachment_file_paths': [resume_path]
    })

print('Target set size (number of emails to send):', len(payloads))
print('Target recipients:', [p['to_email'] for p in payloads])

# ---- Send emails ----
gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='jar_calhoun@gmail.com', password=pass_map['gmail'])['access_token']

send_results = []
for p in payloads:
    resp = apis.gmail.send_email(
        email_addresses=[p['to_email']],
        subject=p['subject'],
        body=p['body'],
        access_token=gmail_token,
        attachment_file_paths=p['attachment_file_paths'],
        file_system_access_token=fs_token
    )
    send_results.append({'company': p['company'], 'to_email': p['to_email'], 'resp': resp})

print('Sent count:', len(send_results))
for r in send_results:
    print(r['company'], '|', r['to_email'], '|', r['resp'])

# Verify sent emails by fetching each sent email via show_email
pass_map = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}

gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='jar_calhoun@gmail.com', password=pass_map['gmail'])['access_token']

sent_email_ids = [20867, 20868, 20869]
expected = {
    20867: 'joseharr@gmail.com',
    20868: 'cheweber@gmail.com',
    20869: 'jamie-solomon@gmail.com'
}

ver = []
for eid in sent_email_ids:
    email_obj = apis.gmail.show_email(email_id=eid, access_token=gmail_token)
    recipients = [r['email'] for r in email_obj.get('recipients', [])]
    attachments = email_obj.get('attachments', [])
    ver.append({
        'email_id': eid,
        'subject': email_obj.get('subject'),
        'to': recipients,
        'expected_to': expected[eid],
        'to_match': expected[eid] in recipients,
        'attachment_file_names': [a['file_name'] for a in attachments]
    })

print('Verification results:')
for row in ver:
    print(row)

# Complete the task
resp = apis.supervisor.complete_task()
print(resp)
